orders.text:
AO No. 209 of 2015
Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Rajat Mittal, Advocate for the 
appellant. 
Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate for the 
respondent no. 1. 
On due consideration, the urgency 
application (IA 4075/2015) is hereby 
allowed. 
Learned counsel for the Insurance 
Company/respondent no.1 has 
submitted that the objections, against the 
delay condonation application (CLMA 
4366/2015), are ready in his hands. 
He is hereby directed to file the 
same in the Registry. 
Respondent no.2 Mr. Narendra 
Kumar is the driver of vehicle and 
respondent nos.3 to 6 are the claimants. 
The dispute pertains between the 
appellant and the Insurance 
Company/respondent no. 1 because 
Insurance Company has made the 
payments as per directions of the 
Tribunal concerned. 
If the appellant deposits half of 
the amount, sought to 
be recovered from him, within a week 
from today, in cash, before the Executing 
Court, recovery in pursuance of the 
impugned judgment shall remain stayed 
till further orders of this Court. 
Stay application (CLMA No.4367 
of 2015) stands disposed of accordingly. 
List this appeal in due course. 
 
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) 17.09.2015 Nadim
